tools.name: Generate_Artillery_Test
tools.description: Creates an Artillery performance test configuration file for load testing REST APIs, web services, and endpoints with customizable load patterns and request scenarios.

templateType.description: Test type: http-get for GET requests, http-post for POST, complex-flow for multi-step, custom for custom YAML

customTemplate.description: Custom Artillery YAML template content (only needed when templateType is custom)

target.description: Base URL of target server (e.g., https://api.example.com, http://localhost:3000)

duration.description: Test duration in seconds per phase. Default: 60

peakRate.description: Peak RPS during ramp-up. Default: 2x arrivalRate

scenarioName.description: Test scenario name. Default: API Test

payload.description: JSON payload for POST requests (string format)

auth.description: Authentication header (Bearer token, Basic auth, etc.)

tools.name: Run_Artillery_Test
tools.description: Executes an Artillery performance test and generates comprehensive HTML reports with stakeholder summaries, technical analysis, and actionable business insights.

testFilePath.description: Path to the Artillery test YAML file to run

generateReport.description: Generate enhanced HTML report with stakeholder summary. Default: true

reportType.description: Report type: enhanced (includes stakeholder summary) or simple (basic metrics only)

tools.name: Analyze_Artillery_Test_Results
tools.description: Analyzes Artillery performance test results, identifies bottlenecks, and provides detailed insights with optimization recommendations for improving API performance.

resultsOutput.description: Artillery test results output, JSON file path, or raw results data to analyze

suggestImprovements.description: Include performance optimization suggestions. Default: true

tools.name: Create_Custom_Artillery_Test
tools.description: Creates a custom Artillery test file with the provided name and content

tools.name: Create_Simple_HTTP_Test
tools.description: Creates a simple HTTP GET performance test with minimal configuration. Perfect for quick load testing of API endpoints with common defaults.

requestsPerSecond.description: Requests per second to generate. Default: 5

testName.description: Name for the test scenario. Default: Simple Load Test
